commits.message: extract data access into a model layer
commits.body:
Move the raw JOIN queries and db_insert calls out of routes/orders.sh
into shellrest/models/orders.sh (orders_find_all/find/find_plain/create).
The JOIN SQL is transcribed verbatim via db_raw_query — not migrated to
db_multi_join, since rewriting a 9-positional-arg helper call to
reproduce the exact same string carries real risk for zero behavior
change. orders_find_plain(id) keeps the POST response's plain
(non-joined) row shape distinct from the joined read view.

Also fixes the same dormant bug already found in products/users:
post_orders called db_insert without capturing its output, then
separately called db_get_last_insert_id in a new sqlite3 connection,
always getting id 0. orders_create now returns db_insert's own id
directly. db_get_last_insert_id() is removed from utils.sh since it
has no remaining callers and is unusable by design (same per-connection
issue already fixed for db_get_changes).

Adds test/unit/models_orders.bats. Completes the MVC extraction:
routes/*.sh now hold only HTTP logic, shellrest/models/*.sh hold all
persistence access.

commits.message: return real affected-row count from db_update/db_delete
commits.body:
db_get_changes() ran SELECT changes() in a brand new sqlite3 connection
via execute_query, but changes() is scoped per-connection — it always
returned 0, so every successful PUT/DELETE across the app incorrectly
responded 404 Not Found.

- db_update/db_delete now run "UPDATE/DELETE ...; SELECT changes();"
  in a single sqlite3 invocation and return the count directly
- remove db_get_changes(), now unusable by design
- update routes/users.sh and the make:controller scaffold template to
  capture the return value instead of calling db_get_changes separately

feat(cli): add unified artisan-style CLI entry point

Introduce bin/shellrest as the single CLI for the framework, replacing the
previous standalone migrate.sh and make_migration.sh scripts. New commands:

- route:list — display registered routes in a formatted table
- make:controller — generate CRUD controller stubs with auto-derived singular forms
- make:migration — generate timestamped migration files (was make_migration.sh)
- migrate — run and manage migrations (was migrate.sh)

Move migration and make-migration logic into shellrest/cli/ as sourced command
libraries. Update new.sh scaffolding to copy bin/ instead of standalone scripts.

HTML-escaped and raw scalar interpolation, and partial rendering.
Wire it into the router to serve dynamic HTML views.

  {{{key}}}, and {{.}} token support
- expose render_view and render_partial as the public rendering API
- add configurable VIEWS_DIR setting with sensible default
- add users list view (views/users_list.html) with per-row partial
- add GET /users/view HTML endpoint in the users route
- source template.sh from api.sh at startup

refactor(server): replace nc+FIFO with socat for request handling

Simplify the HTTP server loop by replacing the netcat + named pipe
approach with a single socat invocation.

- drop manual FIFO creation, trap cleanup, and while loop
- use socat with fork and reuseaddr for concurrent connection handling
- remove stale Spanish inline comments

commits.message:
refactor(db): return last insert row ID directly from db_insert

Make db_insert return the newly inserted row ID in a single SQL
execution instead of requiring a separate db_get_last_insert_id call.

- append SELECT last_insert_rowid() to db_insert query to return the
  generated ID atomically
- refactor post_users route to capture the ID directly from db_insert
  result, removing the extra db_get_last_insert_id invocation
- replace dd with head -c in api.sh body reader for simpler HTTP body
  extraction
